name: Local AI Tooling
description: Installs Aider, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Claude Code, and connects them to a shared Ollama instance running on the host machine.

model.description: Ollama model for Aider and Continue.dev chat. Best for reasoning and agentic coding. Set to 'none' to skip Ollama setup. Examples: qwen3:32b, deepseek-r1:70b, qwen2.5-coder:32b

autocomplete-model.description: Ollama model for Continue.dev tab completion. Should be small and fast. Set to 'none' to use the same model as 'model'. Examples: qwen2.5-coder:7b, qwen2.5-coder:14b
